# Traceback

> AI-assisted digital forensics that turns fragmented telemetry into an
> evidence-backed incident timeline. Every claim is labelled FACT, CORRELATION,
> or INFERENCE and links back to the raw event ids it came from.
>
> Built on a React 19 / Vite / TanStack starter with a Hono API server on Bun.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention: a concise map
for AI agents. Full conventions are in AGENTS.md.

## Stack

- React 19 + TypeScript (strict)
- Vite (build/dev), TanStack Router (file-based, `src/routes/`), TanStack Query
- TailwindCSS v4 + shadcn/ui on Base UI primitives
- Hono API server on Bun (`server/`)
- Supabase (Postgres, RLS enabled) for investigation state
- Modal (Python, `modal/`) for sandboxed telemetry simulation
- OpenAI for report generation, constrained to arranging derived findings
- Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom)

## Conventions

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): canonical conventions, commands, structure, checklist
- Use `bun`/`bunx`, never `npm`/`npx`
- Run `bun run verify` (lint + typecheck + format + test + build) before "done"
- `src/routeTree.gen.ts` is generated — never edit by hand
- Secrets are server-side only; never use a `VITE_` prefix for them

## Domain rules

- Findings are FACT, CORRELATION, or INFERENCE. An INFERENCE must cite the
  correlations under it and is only ever confirmed by a human.
- The LLM never sees raw telemetry and cannot invent events: it references
  findings by id, and unknown ids are discarded before any write.
- Missing integrations degrade rather than break, and fallbacks are labelled.

## Entry points

- `src/main.tsx`: app entry
- `src/routes/__root.tsx`: root layout
- `src/routes/traceback.tsx`: investigation UI route
- `src/index.css`: Tailwind + design tokens (incl. evidence-tier tokens)
- `server/index.ts`: API routes
- `server/pipeline.ts`: correlation pipeline (pure functions, unit-tested)
- `server/llm.ts`: constrained report generation
- `modal/modal_sim.py`: sandboxed simulation
